page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8y.small is an entry-level memory-optimized instance powered by Alibaba Cloud custom arm64 Yitian YiTian710 processors clocked at 2.75 GHz. Configured with a dedicated allocation of 1 physical core and 1 vCPU without multithreading, it features 64 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a 64 MB L3 cache segment. The instance provides 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a generous 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio. It includes no bundled local NVMe storage, relying on network-attached storage, and provides a 1 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without integrated GPU acceleration.

Benchmark results demonstrate adequate single-threaded performance balanced against aggregate single-core resource limits. In stress-ng testing, single-core CPU throughput reached 1762.39, matching the multi-core result due to the single-vCPU ceiling. Data compression benchmarks show capable handling with single-threaded gzip compression at 27.47 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 9.36 GB/sec. Conversely, memory bandwidth is constrained under high throughput tests, recording 18.26 GB/sec read and 7.15 GB/sec write on uncached 256MB blocks. Synthetic database tests yielded 1003.84 operations in PassMark and 1.46 million Redis SET operations per second.

The primary architectural tradeoff of the ecs.r8y.small is its pairing of high per-core memory capacity with a strictly single-threaded ARM compute boundary. It provides an efficient entry profile for memory-sensitive tasks that require minimal compute footprint. Appropriate workloads include lightweight in-memory caches, small-scale Redis or Memcached instances, staging databases, background ETL processing, and low-traffic ARM-targeted microservices.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8y.small is a memory-optimized cloud instance built on the custom arm64 Alibaba Yitian YiTian710 processor running at 2.75 GHz. The instance is configured with 1 dedicated physical core (1 vCPU, 1 thread) and 8.0 GB of RAM, offering a high 1:8 compute-to-memory ratio suitable for memory-heavy entry tiers. Hardware resources include 64 MB of L3 cache, a 1 Gbps baseline network interface, zero bundled local storage, and no GPU accelerators. In benchmarks, it exhibits solid single-threaded capabilities, registering 1762.39 in stress-ng CPU tests and 27.47 GB/sec in gzip compression, while bounded by its single-vCPU limit in throughput-heavy parallel tasks and recording 1.46 million operations per second in Redis SET operations. This profile makes ecs.r8y.small a practical choice for lightweight in-memory caching, low-volume operational databases, background queue workers, and development or staging environments for ARM architecture.
